decisions.decision: Ms. Doherty will speak to the Town Manager about the size of the road signs directing people to the Eagle House.
decisions.quote: ms. doherty said she'd speak to the town manager to see what could be done about the size of the signs.

decisions.decision: Ms. Doherty will go to the Stillman Fair site the night before the fair to set up the COA booth.
decisions.quote: ms. doherty explained that she will go to the stillman fair site the night before to set up the booth.

decisions.decision: Some Formula Grant funding will be used to move the outdoor pickle ball program indoors to the TC Passios gymnasium for the winter, after CORI checks are completed for those running it and attendance documentation for those over 60 is in place.
decisions.quote: some funding will go toward bringing that program indoors to the tc passios gymnasium for the winter months, after cori checks are completed
